name: Government Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Data Centre - Kavadarci candidate scenarios
developer: Government of North Macedonia / Ministry of Interior; EU IPA support
notes: Re-checked 2026-08-12 per MK methodology (Kavadarci = historical BCDR candidate only): EU IPA project fiche identified Kavadarci scenarios for adapting an existing building as a BCDR data centre (60-120 rack options, EUR 1.4m-3.1m), but later IPA reporting confirms the implemented state-of-the-art BCDR Data Centre is in Prilep, so the Kavadarci candidate was not selected. No active Kavadarci datacenter project found in 2026 searches. why_this_is_a_data_center: candidate BCDR data-centre facility in EU feasibility documentation. what_is_not_confirmed: any construction, permit, or operational status at Kavadarci.
